name: go-module-selection-is-module-granular
body: The Go arm's `--module` selection is module-granular: `dirAllowed` compares each discovered module's own directory, so a value naming a package directory inside a module selects nothing, and a sibling-subtree fixture must give each selected subtree its own `go.mod`. Upgrade when the Go frontend gains package-subtree selection (then discovery and `dirAllowed` must admit package dirs, and the fixture can return to one root module).
